title: tiny-charts
tagline: Auto-pick playable statecharts and diagrams in one HTML with Show the logic.
prompt: Create an interactive playable diagram of our checkout payment flow: Cart Ready -> Authorizing -> 3DS Challenge -> Confirmed, with Card Declined allowing up to 2 retries or Cancel. Auto-pick the best chart type, explain why, and include Light/Dark mode plus a Show the logic toggle.
outputs: Auto-picked chart type (Statechart, Sequence, Flowchart, Timeline, or Sankey) with rationale
Single self-contained HTML5 file driven by a declarative CHART_SPEC statechart engine
Synchronized Show the logic (Rules + Flowchart) toggle with Light/Dark mode
